name: rebuild sampler engine + zh ids
command: cat /tmp/fwd.c | ssh -o BatchMode=yes luigi@spark 'cat > ~/bonsai2/asm/fwd.c && cd ~/bonsai2/asm && LB=~/bonsai2/llama.cpp/build/bin && gcc -O2 -fopenmp -march=armv8.2-a+dotprod -c fwd.c -o fwd.o 2>&1 | grep -i " error" | head -5; gcc -O2 -fopenmp -o fwd_mt fwd.o fwd_neon_mt.o fwht.S -L$LB -lggml-base -lggml-cpu -Wl,-rpath,$LB -lm 2>&1 | head -5 && echo BUILD_OK && echo "=== ZH IDS:" && ./tokdetok tokstr ../models/Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-PTQ1_0.gguf "請列出四季，以及每一季會改變的一件事。" 2>/dev/null' 2>&1 | head -8
